title: Flow Record
governance_note: Infrastructure outputs cannot be interpreted responsibly if flow definitions are unclear.

title: Capacity Record
governance_note: Nominal capacity may differ from effective capacity.

title: Queue Record
governance_note: Average throughput can hide waiting-time and backlog effects.

title: Bottleneck Record
governance_note: The apparent bottleneck may shift under disruption or demand change.

title: Maintenance Record
governance_note: Capacity should not be assumed fixed without maintenance records.

title: Resilience Record
governance_note: Spare capacity may be essential resilience, not waste.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Infrastructure conclusions should not exceed flow definitions, capacity evidence, operating conditions, uncertainty, governance feasibility, and tested scope.
